description: TechBitz AI Solutions is building an intelligent data analytics and visualization tool for the "Be An Earth System Trend Detective!" challenge. Our mission is to analyze NASA's satellite datasets (MODIS, AIRS, GPM, MERRA-2) to detect environmental trends, calculate statistical significance (p-value, Mann-Kendall test), and deliver user-friendly insights for researchers and students
summary: Earth Trend Detective is an advanced climate analytics web application developed by team TechBitz AI Solutions for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. It queries real-time NASA POWER API datasets to analyze environmental trends and execute Mann-Kendall time-series statistical tests. Designed to bridge raw satellite climate data with actionable ecological insights, the application features an intuitive, high-performance interface built using FastAPI and Next.js, empowering researchers and communities to detect significant long-term environmental shifts effortlessly
details:
Project Overview: Earth Trend Detective

Team: TechBitz AI Solutions

1. What does it do and how does it work? Earth Trend Detective is an advanced climate analytics web application designed to bridge raw satellite data with actionable ecological insights. It queries real-time datasets from the NASA POWER API and programmatically executes Mann-Kendall time-series statistical tests to detect significant long-term environmental trends and shifts.

2. What benefits and intended impact does it have? The application empowers environmental researchers, policymakers, and local communities to monitor and understand climate anomalies effortlessly. By translating complex scientific datasets into clear, digestible visualizations, it drives data-backed ecological awareness and timely environmental interventions.

3. Tools, Coding Languages, Hardware, and Software Used:

  • Frontend & Backend: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, FastAPI, and Flask.
  • APIs & Data Analysis: NASA POWER API datasets and statistical modeling libraries for time-series evaluation.
  • Deployment & Workflow: Vercel and Google Cloud Run.

4. Creativity and Design Considerations: Our team focused on a seamless user experience (UI/UX) combining high-performance backend pipelines with an intuitive bilingual interface. We carefully considered data accuracy, latency reduction through robust caching, and responsive design to ensure accessibility across devices for diverse user groups
